title: SerialDash widget — shared definitions
description: Shared definitions reused by every widget schema. Not a message on its own.

identifier.description: Up to 16 characters, starting with a letter or underscore. Widget ids and channel ids are separate namespaces, so a widget and a channel are allowed to share the same id.

zone.description: [from, to, color] range used by gauge/level zones.

channels.description: Channels displayed by the widget (`ch`). A single id, or an array of ids for multi-channel widgets.

widgetBase.description: Properties common to every widget declared with a `w` message.

k.description: Widget kind — selects which schema in this directory the rest of the message must match (e.g. `line`, `gauge`, `button`). Fixed once the widget is declared; a later `u` update cannot change it.

title.description: Display title shown on the widget's card. Falls back to the widget's `id` if omitted.

grp.description: Group name. Widgets sharing a `grp` are shown together under one dashboard tab; widgets with no `grp` land in the default tab.

ord.description: Placement order within the widget's group — lower values are placed first. Widgets with no `ord` are placed after the ones that have one, in declaration order.

size.description: Suggested size as `[width, height]` in dashboard grid cells (the grid is 12 columns wide). Only a starting point — the user can resize the widget afterward, and that override takes precedence from then on.

unit.description: Unit suffix shown next to the value, e.g. `"C"` or `"rpm"`.

labels.description: Labels for each channel in `ch`, matched up positionally (first label for the first channel, and so on).

colors.description: Colors for each channel in `ch`, matched up positionally, as #RRGGBB.

stale.description: Seconds of no new data before the widget dims and shows as stale. Default 5.

controlExtras.description: Properties added to controls (button, switch, slider, number, select, text, color) on top of widgetBase. A control's `id` doubles as its state channel id, so controls don't use `ch`.

val.description: Initial/confirmed value, shown until the first `d` or control response arrives for this id. Type depends on the control: boolean for switch, number for slider/number, string for text/select/color.

dis.description: Shows the control as disabled — the user can't interact with it until this is cleared.

confirm.description: Confirmation prompt text. If set, the app asks the user to confirm with this message before sending the command.
